caseName: Journeymen Tailors Union Local No. 195 of the Amalgamated Clothing Workers v. Miller's, Inc.
caseNameFull: Journeymen Tailors Union Local No. 195 of the Amalgamated Clothing Workers of America v. Miller's, Inc.
attorneys: Mr. A. J. Isserman for petitioners. Mr. Louis R. Kagan for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted and the judgment is reversed. American Federation of Labor v. Swing, ante, p. 321; Thornhill v. Alabama, 310 U. S. 88; Carlson v. California, 310 U. S. 106.
